name: Burkina Faso
shortSummary: India's engagement with Burkina Faso is modest and has been complicated by political instability following recent military coups.

majorChallenges.title: Political instability
majorChallenges.description: Recent coups and a shifting regional security situation in the Sahel constrain deeper ties.
